reference.title: Product version reference
reference.shortdesc: Use the BPM header and version context to confirm which product and documentation version you are using.

section.title: Version location
section.p: The page header displays the running BPM version, and the documentation package is built for BPM.

section.title: Version scope
section.p: The product version identifies BPM behavior, not the Firefox browser version installed on an endpoint.

section.title: Schema version
section.p: Firefox schema channels such as ESR 140.12 and Release 152 are separate choices that affect validation and available controls.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If product behavior does not match the guide, record the BPM version, schema channel, route, locale, and visible status before reporting the mismatch.
